name: msg_id
description: Deterministic message id set by the producer (e.g. binance:BTCUSDT:trade:123). Used for de-duplication.

name: event_type
description: Event type as detected by the producer (attribute), e.g. trade.

name: symbol
description: Trading pair as detected by the producer, e.g. BTCUSDT.

name: event_ts
description: Event time used as Beam element timestamp (exchange time; producer receive time if the event has none).

name: ingest_ts
description: When the producer received the message from the WebSocket. Partition column.

name: payload
description: Original WebSocket frame, byte-for-byte as received (UTF-8). Use PARSE_JSON(payload) to query.
